messages.subject: point transects
parts:
Dear list members,

I have data collected from fixed observations points, and was wondering if=20
the data could be suitable to estimate density considernig the observation=20
points as point transects.=20

I have 8 different observation points randomly distributed in the survey=20
area. Observations were done simountaneously from all observation points.=20
From each point a regular scan of the observed area was done every three=20
minutes. During each of these events the radial distance to each animal=20
seen was taken. Observation sessions lasted 1hour and a half for a total of =

30 scans for each point.=20

Of course there is a high possibility that many animals were counted=20
repeatedly, from the same observation point or animals seen repeatedly in=20
different points. There are also many scans with no observation at all. Do=20
you think this kind of data is suitable for a robust point transect=20
analysis or not? Should I consider the 30 scans as =93survey effort=94 for e=
ach=20
point transect or how?

I would be glad of any idea and imput you can give me!

Achaz von Hardenberg
Alpine Wildlife Research Centre
Gran Paradiso National Park, Italy
